Torque’N Threads Affiliate Program

join the Torque’N Threads affiliate team and get rewarded for sharing a brand built for car culture.


We’re looking for creators, car enthusiasts, and community members who want to represent a brand that takes automotive clothing seriously. As an affiliate, you’ll earn commission on every sale made through your unique referral link or discount code.


How you earn

• Receive a personal affiliate link or discount code

• Earn commission on every order made through your link

• Potential bonuses for top-performing affiliates and campaign drops

• Early access to new releases and exclusive affiliate perks


How you can promote us

• Post photos or videos wearing the gear on Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube

• Feature the clothing in car meets, builds, or automotive content

• Share your personal affiliate link in your bio, stories, or videos

• Showcase the lifestyle around the brand — cars, culture, and community


What separates Torque’N Threads


Most automotive clothing brands rely on generic print-on-demand tees. We don’t.


Every piece is built from the ground up with custom designs, premium fabrics, and tailored fits. Our garments are designed to represent automotive culture without looking like cheap merch.


This is automotive clothing you can wear anywhere — at a car meet, in the gym, out with friends, or every day — while still carrying a strong foundation in real car culture.


If you’re passionate about cars and want to earn while representing a brand that does things differently, apply to become a Torque’N Threads affiliate.
